name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or flag improvement for grg
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'type:feature'
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem or use case is. Ex. "I am always frustrated when I want to search..."

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen, including proposed command-line flags or syntax (e.g. `--new-flag`, ripgrep parity).

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered, or how this is handled by `rg` / `git log`.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, benchmarks, example output formatting, or screenshots about the feature request here.
